| [`link-parameters-computed.html`](https://wpt.fyi/results/css/css-link-params/link-parameters-computed.html) | Fail | 10 / 12 | TEST BUG, NOT IMPLEMENTED | `link-parameters-substitution.html` uses the comma of the former grammar (`param(--color, var(--brand))`), which the specification replaced with a colon (`param(--color: var(--brand))`): the declarations are invalid; CSS Linked Parameters (`link-parameters`, the `param()` modifier of `url()`): the property is parsed with the grammar of webref only (`param( <param-spec> [ ':' <declaration-value>? ]? )`), so the typed parameters with `type()` (`param(--a type(<color>): orange)`) are rejected, the parameters without value (`param(--a)`, `param(--a red)`) are accepted, the empty value (`param(--a: )`) is not serialized as the browsers do and `currentcolor` is computed; no browser implements the specification |
